subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and secure transfer instructions
messages:
From: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@acmehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and related materials

Hi Logan,

We're kicking off our security review for the upcoming procurement cycle and I'd like to request Redwood Inference's latest SOC 2 Type II report covering your production inference platform. Specifically we need:
- The final SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- A bridge letter if the report's coverage doesn't include our desired audit window
- A short scope matrix that lists which services/systems were in-scope
- Your preferred secure transfer method for sensitive artifacts

Also: can you confirm the audit period covered (start/end dates) and whether you have a control exceptions note or management response included? Our procurement team prefers artifacts delivered via SFTP or an encrypted Share link.

Thanks,
Tom Baxter
Security Operations
Acme Health

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and related materials

Hi Tom — thanks for the note and for outlining what you need. Looping in Marissa (security/compliance) and Neha (legal) so we can assemble the right package.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide the final SOC 2 Type II report PDF and a bridge letter when required.
- Typical delivery options: secure Share (expiring link), SFTP account (temporary creds), or a signed NDA + DocuSign transfer if you require.
- Our standard SOC 2 package includes the report PDF and a scope matrix; management responses are included when there are documented exceptions.

Couple of clarifying Qs to help us prepare the package:
1) Which audit window do you need covered (e.g., FY dates or rolling 12 months)?
2) Do you need an explicit attestation of data segregation for dedicated deployments, or will the standard scope matrix suffice?
3) Any procurement identifier or HubSpot/DocuSign link we should reference for tracking?

We can target delivery within 2 business days after you confirm the desired transfer method and audit window. If you need redacted copies for public distribution, we can provide those as well.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@acmehealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and related materials — contents & transfer

Hi Tom — Marissa from Redwood's security team here. Thanks for reaching out. Below is what we typically include in an initial SOC 2 Type II delivery and our recommended secure transfer options. Feel free to forward this to your procurement team.

What we provide (standard package):
- SOC 2 Type II Report (PDF) — final signed report from our CPA firm.
- Bridge Letter (DOCX/PDF) — used when you need evidence for a period after the report's testing window; we include a template and can generate a signed bridge for qualifying requests.
- Scope Matrix (XLSX) — systems/services in-scope and any segmentation notes (e.g., hosted API vs Dedicated).
- Control Exceptions & Management Responses (if applicable) — included as a short appendix.
- Evidence Index (list of artifact IDs) — for auditors that request deeper dives.

Redaction policy: we can produce a redacted copy for public sharing and an unredacted copy for procurement/audit under a secure transfer and an NDA where required.

Secure delivery options (we recommend one of the following):
1) Secure Share (expiring link) — recommended for most customers. Link will be encrypted and expire after 14 days.
2) SFTP — we can provision a one-time SFTP account and credentials; credentials expire after 5 days.
3) Encrypted e-mail attachment via your tenant's secure mail gateway (if you prefer).

Audit window clarification: the most recent Type II report covers 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 (testing period). If you need coverage beyond 2025-09-30 we can provide a bridge letter to cover the gap up to the requested date, subject to our control assessment cutoff.

To proceed, please confirm:
- Desired secure transfer option (Secure Share or SFTP).
- Exact audit period you require (if different from the period above).
- Any procurement/reference IDs for tracking (HubSpot record, PO#).

Attachments included in this email: SOC2_TypeII_2024-10.pdf (signed report), Bridge_Letter_Template_2025.docx, SOC2_Scope_Matrix.xlsx

If helpful, below are two short reply templates you can paste into your procurement thread:

-- Procurement reply (redacted/public):
"Redwood has provided a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30. A redacted copy is available for public review and an unredacted copy can be shared via secure transfer under an NDA."

-- Procurement reply (detailed):
"We have received the SOC 2 Type II report (signed) and scope matrix from Redwood. For unredacted access and any bridge letter requests, please confirm secure transfer preference (SFTP or expiring secure link) and provide PO#/HubSpot ID for tracking."

Thanks — once you confirm transfer preference we'll send the link and credentials.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

We need coverage through 2025-11-30 for our internal review. Please proceed with the bridge letter that extends coverage from 2025-10-01 through 2025-11-30. Secure Share is preferred for delivery (expiring link). Our procurement reference is PO# ACME-4332 and HubSpot company ID ACME-91.
